summary: Opens the 大盘 (Taiwan weighted index) section: follow the index trend to raise the stock-picking success rate, and trade the index only in swings (only one or two big swings a year; never short-term trade). Five case studies of the TAIEX 1997-2000 (daily and weekly) apply the earlier pattern toolkit to the index: head breakdowns (破线头部确立) after a volume climax with price/volume divergence, equal-distance decline/advance targets (跌幅满足/涨幅满足, two-wave targets), a weak rebound ending in a 假突破, the 1999 破底翻 bottom, a neckline breakout with first- and second-wave targets, and a weekly triangle breakout. Each case gives entry level, neckline-reclaim stop with % risk (1%-3.3%) and realised % profit.

patterns.name_zh: 破线头部确立（指数做空）
patterns.name_en: Head confirmed by neckline breakdown (index short)
patterns.structure: A top area (盘头) with a rising neckline/trendline under the highs; often preceded by a volume climax (爆量/天量) followed by 价涨量缩 divergence. A long black candle breaking the neckline (长黑摜破颈线) confirms the head.
patterns.entry: Short on the day the neckline is broken by a long black candle (破线头部确立空单进场); e.g. 1997/9/2 short ~9340, 1998/4/14 short ~8735, 1998/7/30 short ~7780, 1998/12 short ~7750.
patterns.stop: Stop when price reclaims the neckline (站回颈线 / 突破...也就是站回颈线时停损), which is also the 翻黑 high; risks quoted 3.3%, 2.8%, 2.1%, ~1%.

target.formula: After price breaks the prior low L of the decline: target = rebound_high H2 - (prior_high H1 - L)  (等幅跌幅满足). Multiple waves can be computed from successive high/low pairs.

confirmation: Long black candle through the neckline.
Prior volume climax then price up / volume down divergence (量价背离) warns of the top.
Decline target only computed once the prior low is broken (跌破前低后便可计算跌幅满足).
invalidation: Price reclaims the neckline (站回颈线) -> stop.

patterns.name_en: False breakout ending a weak rebound
patterns.structure: After reaching a decline target, the index rebounds slowly (e.g. ~3 months, ~1200-1269 pts, structurally weak relative to the prior fall), briefly pushes above a prior high/upper line (7488 above 7218/7249) and falls back; then breaks the rising rebound trendline.
patterns.entry: Short when the rebound trendline/neckline breaks after the false breakout (破线头部确立), ~7750 in Dec 1998.
patterns.stop: Reclaim of the neckline / the 翻黑 high, ~7830 (risk ~1%).

target.formula: A confirmed false breakout usually breaks the prior low; once broken, target = false-breakout high - (prior high - prior low).

confirmation: Weak, slow rebound relative to the long-term decline.
Break of the rebound's rising trendline after the false breakout.

patterns.name_en: Break-bottom reversal at an index bottom
patterns.structure: At/near the decline target the index breaks below the neckline/prior low (5988) to a new low (5422), then within 1-2 weeks reclaims the neckline with consecutive gap-up long red candles (连续二个跳空长红); the second long red (1999/2/22) stands back above 5988 = 破底翻确立.
patterns.entry: Buy when the 破底翻 is confirmed by reclaiming the neckline (5988); add on the later neckline breakout (1999/3/15 ~6580).
patterns.stop: For the neckline-breakout entry: break of the breakout long red's low 6440 (跌落线下), risk ~2.2%.

target.formula: 破底翻 typically goes on to break the prior high (7488). After the subsequent neckline breakout: target_1 = breakout + (neckline - low); target_2 = target_1 + same distance.

confirmation: Occurs at/near a computed decline target.
Brief time below the neckline (1-2 weeks).
invalidation: Failure to hold back above the neckline (implied; not stated explicitly for this case).

patterns.name_zh: 突破颈线底部确立与第二波涨幅满足
patterns.name_en: Neckline breakout bottom with first- and second-wave targets
patterns.structure: Base whose neckline ~6550 sits above the low 5422; long red candle breaks the neckline (1999/3/15). After reaching target 1 the index consolidates ~2 months (box 7209.51-7705.63) and a long red (6/7) breaks the box's upper neckline to new highs.
patterns.entry: Buy on the long red neckline breakout (~6580); add/hold on the 6/7 consolidation breakout.
patterns.stop: Break of the breakout long red candle's low 6440 (risk ~2.2%).

target.formula: target_1 = breakout + (neckline - low); target_2 = target_1 + (neckline - low). Cross-check: a short-wave target = consolidation low + (short-wave high - short-wave start).

confirmation: Long red breakout candle whose low holds (当日长红低点6440点不破).
Two independent target calculations land near the same level (都在大约的位置).
invalidation: Close below the breakout long red low 6440.
At target: 7/13 带量长黑 breaks a ~1-month top's neckline -> exit.

patterns.name_en: Triangle consolidation breakout with measured move (weekly)
patterns.structure: After the 8710 high, ~half a year of converging triangle consolidation (8710.71/8414.60 highs, 6771.75/7261.31 lows); the week of 1999/12/25 breaks the triangle's upper neckline, and 2 weeks later breaks the prior high 8710.
patterns.entry: Buy on the triangle upper-neckline breakout (~8020); target calculation enabled once prior high 8710 is broken.
patterns.stop: The broken neckline becomes support; buy-stop risk ~2.5% (颈线反压突破变支撑，不破看涨幅满足附近).

target.formula: Method 1 (large wave): low_start + (high - prior_low) i.e. 6771 + (8710 - 5422). Method 2 (triangle): breakout point + triangle side length (vertical height at the 8710 high).

confirmation: Breaking the prior high 8710 two weeks after the triangle breakout.
invalidation: Falling back below the triangle neckline.

rules.rule: Watch the index and trade stocks in the direction of the index trend for a higher success rate.
rules.quote_zh: 观察大盘，随大盘趋势，操作个股才会有更高的成功率。

rules.rule: Index (futures) trading must also be swing trading; only a few swings a year, the big ones maybe only one or two, but very profitable.
rules.quote_zh: 指数的操作也是必须波段操作，一年可以做的波段没有几次，较大的波段甚至可能少至一两次

rules.rule: Never try short-term trading; it becomes a habit and fails.
rules.quote_zh: 投资人千万不要尝试短线，那会成为习惯，必败无疑。

rules.rule: At a rare turning point (bull or bear), enter aggressively with a strict stop: small losses, big gains; catching one or two big swing turns a year is success.
rules.quote_zh: 一旦出现难得的转折，无论是多头转折或空头转折，积极介入，严设停损，小赔大赚，一年只要抓到一两次的较大波段转折，便是成功的操作。

rules.rule: After a heavy-volume day there is usually still a higher high; then price rises on shrinking volume (divergence) before the top.
rules.quote_zh: 技术面大量后通常都还会有高点，随后价涨量缩量价背离。

rules.rule: A long black candle breaking the neckline confirms the head and is a long-term sell signal.
rules.quote_zh: 同年9月2日长黑摜破颈线头部，确立为长线卖出信号

rules.rule: The decline target is computed only after price breaks the prior low.
rules.quote_zh: 直到跌破前低7040点后，便可计算跌幅满足。

rules.rule: Short stop = price reclaiming the neckline (站回颈线).
rules.quote_zh: 约可空在9340点附近，突破9650点也就是站回颈线时停损，风险约3.3%

rules.rule: A slow, small rebound after a big decline is structurally weak; it ended with a false breakout, then broke the neckline for another leg down.
rules.quote_zh: 在长线结构上属于相对弱势反弹，反弹波在假突破后结束，随后跌破颈线再跌一波才见底。

rules.rule: Cover shorts near the decline target.
rules.quote_zh: 达跌幅满足附近，空单回补获利约20%~34%。

rules.rule: A confirmed false breakout usually breaks the prior low; then compute the decline target.
rules.quote_zh: 技术面假突破确立通常都会跌破前低（6219点），跌破前低后便能计算跌幅满足。

rules.rule: A confirmed 破底翻 usually goes on to break the prior high.
rules.quote_zh: 技术面破底翻确立后通常都会突破前高

rules.rule: Short stop at the neckline-reclaim level, which is also the 翻黑 high; risk can be as low as ~1%. If the reclaim fails, hold for the decline target.
rules.quote_zh: 停损设在7830点附近，也就是站回颈线反压，也是翻黑高点，风险仅约1%，反压站不回看跌幅满足附近

rules.rule: As in many examples, after a false breakout turns bearish, the bear phase ends with a 破底翻 stabilisation buy signal.
rules.quote_zh: 如同许多例子一样，假突破翻空后，最终以破底翻企稳买进信号结束空头。

rules.rule: Use the weekly chart as an auxiliary reference to the daily operation.
rules.quote_zh: 参考前一篇日线，周线做为辅助操作。

rules.rule: After a long-red neckline breakout, as long as that candle's low holds, look for the bottom's measured-move target; break of the long red low is the stop.
rules.quote_zh: 技术面当日长红低点6440点不破，看底部计算的涨幅满足附近。

rules.rule: A breakout to new highs from a consolidation after target 1 allows computing the second-wave target.
rules.quote_zh: 同年6月7日突破整理区上缘颈线再创新高后，便可计算第二波涨幅满足。

rules.rule: Scale out at target 1, exit fully at target 2, especially on a neckline-break 翻黑 head confirmation.
rules.quote_zh: 达涨幅满足7661点附近多单减码，再达第二波涨幅满足附近，尤其是7月13日破线翻黑头部确立时，多单获利了结约16%~31%。

rules.rule: Triangle measured move: rise after the breakout equals the triangle's side length.
rules.quote_zh: 突破颈线后的涨幅=三角形边长的等幅。

rules.rule: Broken resistance neckline becomes support; if it holds, look for the measured target.
rules.quote_zh: 颈线反压突破变支撑，不破看涨幅满足附近

rules.rule: Diversification is ignorance-hedging (O'Neil quote); hedging a losing position by shorting other things is a big mistake (Gann quote); control losses and accept them (Schwartz quote).
rules.quote_zh: 多样化只是一种避险的无知

worked_examples.pattern: 爆量后量价背离 + 破线头部确立 + 跌幅满足
worked_examples.outcome: Three head breakdowns (1997/9/2, 1998/4/14, 1998/7/30); risks 3.3%/2.8%/2.1%; low 6219 near target 6162; shorts covered for ~20%-34%.
Feb 1999 low 5422 near targets; stayed only 1-2 weeks, then 破底翻 ended the long bear.

worked_examples.pattern: 假突破 -> 破线 -> 跌幅满足 -> 破底翻
worked_examples.outcome: Short ~7750 with ~1% risk, ~30% profit; 破底翻 confirmed 1999/2/22 at 5988; later broke 7488.

worked_examples.pattern: 破底翻 + 突破颈线底部确立 + 第二波涨幅满足
worked_examples.outcome: Bought 1999/3/15 ~6580, risk ~2.2%; scaled out at 7661, exited near 8789/7-13 head break; profit ~16%-31%.

worked_examples.pattern: 三角形整理突破 + 涨幅满足
worked_examples.outcome: Breakout week 1999/12/25; risk ~2.5%, profit ~22% (stated on p132).

quantifiable: Index regime filter: only take stock longs when the index is not in a confirmed head (破线头部确立) and its decline target is not yet reached; mirror for shorts.

Head confirmation: close below the top area's rising neckline with a long black candle (body > N x ATR) after a volume climax (volume = max of last 250 bars) followed by higher price highs on lower volume.
Decline target activation: only after close < prior swing low L; target = rebound_high - (prior_high - L). Treat 'near target' as within ~1-3% (book examples: 6219 vs 6162, 5422 vs 5591/5811).
Short stop = close back above the broken neckline (or the breakdown candle's high); risk% = (stop - entry)/entry, book cases 1%-3.3% on daily index.
Long-red breakout stop = close below that candle's low.
Second-wave target = target_1 + (neckline - low), activated by a breakout to new highs out of the post-target_1 consolidation.
Triangle target = breakout price + vertical height of the triangle at its widest (first) pivot.
False breakout after a weak rebound: price > prior range high then closes back below within a few bars, plus a break of the rebound's rising trendline -> short; expect break of prior low.
ambiguities: 'Weak rebound' is described qualitatively (3 months, ~1200-1269 points against a 4037-point fall); no threshold is given.
'附近' (near target) tolerance is unspecified; actual lows overshoot or undershoot targets by up to ~170 points (5422 vs 5591).
Neckline breakout level used in arithmetic (6533) differs from the neckline (6550) and the entry (6580); which reference to use is not formalised.
Triangle 'side length' (边长约2180) measurement point is loosely defined (vertical line at the 8710 high).
The weekly 1999 bottom was computed with two different high/low pairs (5811 vs 5591); no rule says which pair to prefer.
The book uses the weekly chart only as auxiliary; how to resolve daily/weekly conflicts is not stated.
Profit ranges (20%-34%, 16%-31%) aggregate several entries; per-entry profit is not given.
